answer_1.quote: We define three tasks -review score prediction, pragmatic labeling and guided skimming -that are anchored in realistic assistance scenarios and targeted towards helping junior reviewers to improve their review.
answer_1.outputs: The paper presents NLG-adjacent tasks focused on generating structured feedback and relevance rankings in peer review contexts, though the primary focus is on analysis and prediction rather than free-form text generation.

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance by the mean root squared error (MRSE)... we also measure the classification performance of the regression model in terms of the F1-score...
